lines.en: My shield rides my left shoulder
The short sword taps my hip
I march to the rhythm of the line
The leather straps pull at my chest
I press forward step by step
My soles grind the gravel
I turn my left side forward
I advance along the shield line
Only half my blade shows
I move low and steady
My shadow hugs the ground
I step around a fallen log
I raise the shield to my brow
I wipe my blade on my sleeve
I tap the ground with my toe
I count the beats of my breath
I watch the gap ahead
I square the shield rim
I roll my wrist once
I crouch and wait
I listen to the steps behind me
I tighten my grip on the hilt
Only my eyes show above the shield
I measure your weapon
You are right in front of me
I turn the blade flat
You are taller, and slower
I push the shield at you
You stand too close to my shield
I look for your sword hand
Your stance has a hole
I tuck the shield in tight
Blood seeps through the seams
The shield nearly left my grip
I grit my teeth and raise it
That one landed hard
I shift my stance and hold
I can still hold the line
A strap has snapped
I take one step back
Do not think I am falling
My stretch is not lost yet
My rations are in my own pack
No eating while the line holds
Do not test me with bread
My captain hands out the meals
Set the meat down and step back
I have to hold this stretch first
I smell roast meat
Wait until my watch ends
There is no time to eat in battle
My shield strikes your chest
I brace you with my shoulder
We clash with a clang
My shield rim catches you
You cannot push this shield
I give half a step
The iron rings, I hold on
You hit the shield's boss
I drop low and hold
This shield took you for me
She refills arrows in the rear
We spoke at the watch change
She tightened my shoulder strap
Our shield rims grind together

lines.zh: 我把她的名字刻在柄上
lines.en: I carved her name on my hilt
She said we would go home after
Two of us hold one stretch of wall
Her wound has not healed
I took an extra watch for her
She fell asleep against me
I pick up a fallen arrow
I pick up an iron nail
I stoop for a shield strap
This stone can hone a blade
I stuff it into my pouch
I find half a loaf
I keep the broken hilt
This belongs to the unit
I weigh it and keep it
I bend and rise again
You are within shield reach
I raise the shield and look for a gap
You left your side open
I fix on your knee
Your swing starts too high
I hold this stretch
The line shifts a step left
Your feet are backing up
I sink low and prepare
I lock onto your chest
You cannot fall back now
I level my point at you
Only one of us fits this path
Do you hear the shield ring
I go on the count of three
This shield is coming for you
I press you aside with the shield
I shorten the distance bit by bit
Your missed swing still sways
I wait for one more swing
The short sword waits behind the shield
I step where you step
Your armor gap is on the right
I herd you toward the wall
Are you looking for a way out
My shield gives you no height
Raise your arm and I slip in
I shift my angle and press
Your breathing has gone heavy
I hear your boot slip
No help is coming here
I can catch you without running
A short sword needs short range
Back up more and you hit the wall
I lift the shield higher
My patience is thicker than this shield
The short sword stabs out
I slam the shield into your chest
The point finds your ribs
My shield rim smashes your hand
I stab once and pull back
I turn so the blade runs true
You stopped the shield, not the blade
I take half a step and pin you
The edge rakes your forearm
The shield knocks you backwards
I stab twice in a row
You guard your head and bare your leg
The short blade hunts the seams
I drop the shield and come in low
This blow comes from my hips
Your sword is trapped under my shield
I kick the back of your knee
The point is on you again
I give you no room to retreat
The line taught me this one
I step out of the line
The shield lands before I do
I settle the strap on my shoulder
My short sword is already drawn
The camp horn sent me here
I raise the shield to my chin
The soil under me is freshly turned
I take my place by the wall
The wind lifts my short cloak
I see the gap in the line
This watch is mine
I pull my helmet down
Fire licks my shield hand
I land hard on my knee
My leather armor drinks water and sinks
The blast throws me behind my shield
An arrow stands in my shield
Magic heat makes me drop my blade
Hungry, the shield grows heavy
Lightning climbs my sword hilt
Falling, my shield flies off first
